parts.label: (i)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: State or imply $du=-\sin x\,dx$ [B1]. Use Pythagoras to express the integral in terms of $u$ [M1]. Obtain integrand $\pm u^{1/2}(1-u^2)$ [A1]. Integrate to obtain $-\dfrac23u^{3/2}+\dfrac27u^{7/2}$, or equivalent [A1]. Change limits correctly and substitute correctly in an integral of the form $au^{3/2}+bu^{7/2}$, or substitute the original limits correctly in the corresponding expression in $\cos x$ [M1]. Obtain $\dfrac8{21}$ [A1]. Total 6.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use the product rule and chain rule at least once [M1]. Obtain the correct derivative in any form [A1 + A1]. Equate the derivative to zero and obtain a horizontal equation in integral powers of $\sin x$ and $\cos x$ [M1]. Use correct methods to obtain an equation in one trigonometric function [M1]. Obtain $\tan^2x=6$, $7\cos^2x=1$, or $7\sin^2x=6$, or equivalent, and obtain $1.183$ [A1]. Total 6.
